question: Investigate the potential biological mechanisms through which Guizhi Decoction may influence palpitations, using traditional medical literature, pharmacological databases, experimental evidence, and computational analysis.
question_zh: 结合传统医学文献、药理数据库、实验证据与计算分析，考察桂枝汤可能影响心悸的生物学机制。
acceptance: Every stage either completes on verified data or ends with a precise, reproducible explanation of why it cannot: the status, the reason, and the command that reproduces it. No stage may invent a compound-target relationship, and no pathway may be presented as an established mechanism.
never: a target relationship that no snapshot edge records
a predicted edge counted as a measured one
a pathway hypothesis stated as an established mechanism
the palpitation record of 桂枝甘草汤 attributed to 桂枝汤 without saying it is reasoning across formulas
a skipped or blocked stage reported as passed

protocol.parameters: bioagent.analysis.network_pharmacology.Parameters() defaults: potency (IC50, Ki, Kd, EC50) at or below 10 µM, composition level C1 or better, assayed-protein background, Benjamini-Hochberg q ≤ 0.05, degree-matched permutation p ≤ 0.05 (1000 permutations, seed 20260923), rebuttals: background sensitivity, leave one activity source out, two other permutation seeds

stages.requirement: Resolve the precise formula version and its historical source.
stages.produces: the workbook record of 桂枝汤《伤寒论》 (row, id, composition as written, source), how many versions the name 桂枝汤 has, and the curated 伤寒论 formula it is checked against
stages.validation: one version cites 《伤寒论》; its crude drugs agree with the curated 伤寒论 formula; the name alone is ambiguous
acceptable_limitations: the workbook's origin and licence are not stated

stages.produces: each herb with its materia id, dose and processing as written, and its NCBI-verified source species
needs: the materia table with verified taxa
stages.validation: every ingredient resolves to a crude drug; every crude drug has at least one NCBI-verified species, or is named as contributing no constituents
acceptable_limitations: a drug without a verified species contributes no compounds, and that is stated

stages.requirement: Identify compounds using real pharmacological databases.
stages.produces: the constituents recorded for the herbs' species in NPASS, CMAUP and LOTUS, with their composition level and source
needs: NPASS, CMAUP and LOTUS files from their upstream servers, verified against their reviewed checksums
stages.validation: the files pass integrity verification; the build reproduces the 葛根芩连汤 marker compounds; each herb with a verified species has recorded constituents or is named as having none
acceptable_limitations: composition is species-level (C1/C2), not the decoction (C3) or plasma (C4)

stages.requirement: Retrieve compound-target associations from validated sources.
stages.produces: the human proteins the constituents were measured against at or below 10 µM, with the number of measurements and their sources
stages.validation: every target rests on at least one measured activity edge in a verified snapshot
acceptable_limitations: potency in an assay is not activity in the body

stages.requirement: Distinguish measured interactions from computational predictions.
stages.produces: each edge class the analysis used, counted as measured or predicted, and the predicted edges it left out
stages.validation: no target and no hypothesis rests on a predicted edge; STRING edges are used only for descriptive topology

stages.requirement: Identify relevant cardiovascular and electrophysiological pathways.
stages.produces: the pre-registered cardiac and electrophysiological Reactome pathways that contain measured targets, with the targets
stages.validation: the pathway set is fixed before the data are read; membership comes from Reactome edges; a pathway named here is a membership, not a mechanism
acceptable_limitations: a pathway renamed in a later Reactome release is reported as not found in that release

stages.requirement: Perform appropriately controlled enrichment analysis when supported by the data.
stages.produces: the over-representation test against the assayed background with BH correction, the degree-matched permutation null, and the three rebuttals
stages.validation: the analysis runs to its verdict; a pathway counts only when it passes BH, the permutation null and every rebuttal
acceptable_limitations: a rebuttal that cannot run (one activity source only) is a limitation, never a pass

stages.requirement: Retrieve relevant experimental and clinical publications.
stages.produces: the records returned by pre-registered Europe PMC and ClinicalTrials.gov queries, with identifiers and publication types
needs: web access to www.ebi.ac.uk and clinicaltrials.gov
stages.validation: each query is sent and its answer recorded with its count; nothing is reported when nothing was sent
acceptable_limitations: records are retrieved by query and typed by their metadata; their findings are not read or graded here

stages.requirement: Evaluate the available evidence and contradictions.
stages.produces: the evidence by type and the claim each type can license, and the contradictions found: the indication recorded for a different formula, mixed measurements of one compound-target pair, pathways refuted by rebuttal
stages.validation: each evidence type is graded by the evidence tiers; a contradiction is computed from the records, not asserted
acceptable_limitations: literature is counted by design, not appraised

stages.produces: the hypotheses that survived analysis and rebuttal, each labelled a mechanism hypothesis, with the edges it rests on and what would test it
stages.validation: every hypothesis is of kind mechanism_hypothesis, cites measured edges only, and its wording claims no more than a hypothesis
acceptable_limitations: when no pathway survives, no hypothesis is licensed and that negative result is reported

stages.requirement: Distinguish Guizhi Decoction from Guizhi Gancao Decoction.
stages.produces: the two compositions, doses and recorded indications side by side, which of them records palpitations (心下悸), and what the shared herbs mean for the analysis
stages.validation: both versions resolve; the record of 心下悸 is attributed to the formula that records it; reasoning from one to the other is marked as such
acceptable_limitations: 桂枝甘草汤's composition is read through a proposed erratum until a maintainer reviews it

stages.requirement: Produce reproducible intermediate and final research artifacts.
stages.produces: one JSON artifact per stage with its SHA-256, a manifest, and the commands that reproduce the run
stages.validation: every artifact is written and hashed; with --repeat the deterministic stages give byte-identical artifacts
acceptable_limitations: live literature results change over time and are excluded from the repeat comparison

pathways.rationale: Palpitations are the perception of the heartbeat; the pre-registered set covers cardiac excitation and its phases, the ion channels and exchangers that carry them, excitation-contraction coupling, and the autonomic receptors that set heart rate. Fixed before any data are read; matched by Reactome stable id or exact name.

cardiac_electrophysiology.name: Phase 1 - inactivation of fast Na+ channels
Activation of G protein gated Potassium channels

europepmc.query: ("Guizhi decoction" OR "Guizhi Tang" OR "Gui Zhi Tang" OR "Guizhi-tang" OR "Keishi-to" OR "桂枝汤") AND (palpitation OR palpitations OR arrhythmia OR arrhythmias OR "heart rate" OR tachycardia OR "atrial fibrillation")
("Guizhi Gancao" OR "Gui Zhi Gan Cao" OR "Guizhi-Gancao" OR "桂枝甘草汤" OR "Cinnamomi Ramulus and Glycyrrhizae") AND (palpitation OR palpitations OR arrhythmia OR heart OR cardiac OR myocardial)
("Guizhi decoction" OR "Guizhi Tang" OR "Gui Zhi Tang" OR "Guizhi-tang" OR "Keishi-to") AND (heart OR cardiac OR cardiovascular OR myocardial OR cardiomyocyte)

clinicaltrials.term: Guizhi OR "Gui Zhi" OR Keishito OR "Keishi-to"
